deviation.message: Scope constraint (human): do NOT move functionality between Java and scripts in this plan — this is a pure mvn->gradle migration in place. So: PublishRelease.java stays Java-only (no gemini logic added to it); release.sh / release-gemini.sh / package-tasks-java.sh keep their current responsibilities and entrypoints, only their mvn calls become gradlew calls. The plan's 'prefer making PublishRelease the single entrypoint / retire the shell scripts' suggestion is explicitly DECLINED. jq stamp is dropped only where it is a verified no-op (manifest already stamped by Gradle expand()).

Task 17's four-payload diff was blocked — render tasks hardcode outputDir to build/render/<variant>/, so no Gradle invocation assembles a full payload (claude/gemini/packaging compose fine; render is the blocker). Task 21 makes render outputDir overridable + adds assembleProd/Gemini/Windows aggregates. Task 17 now Depends-on 16,18,20,21.

plan-71-v8: reworked payload assembly into 5 per-variant tasks (21 assembleClaudeDev, 22 GeminiDev, 23 ClaudeProd, 24 GeminiProd, 25 Windows), migrated one at a time starting ClaudeDev. Deleted the stale/inconsistent committed build*/ dirs; parity baseline is now a fresh mvn -P<profile> build per variant. JS/TS copies move out of packaging (assembly must not invoke packaging). Task 17 now Depends-on 16,21,22,23,24,25.

plan-71-v9: design decision recorded — NO default variants. The Maven -Pvariant/activeByDefault ?:'dev' fallback was a Maven-land UI shortcut; Gradle won't have it. claude/gemini manifest tasks become per-variant via a factory (copyClaudeMetaDev/Prod, copyGeminiDev/Prod); each assembleX depends on its own variant's task; no global variant property. Lands incrementally across Tasks 21-25.

plan-71-v10: fix inverted dependency. assembleClaude*/assembleGemini* move into the claude/gemini integration modules (not skills/pkg). skills/pkg exposes render+copy as reusable parameterized building blocks; integration modules drive them with explicit output dir + variant (no shared global -Pbuild.outputDir). Direction is integration->skills:pkg, never reverse. The Task-21 draft's skills/pkg->:claude:copyPluginMeta dependsOn is being corrected.

plan-71-v11: dual-mode assembly (supersedes v10 consumable-config hand-off). Dev = producers co-deposit directly into build/<variant> (fast, no copy), guarded by a buildSrc overlap-check that FAILS on intersecting declared producer outputs (file-granular, declares inputs so it's UP-TO-DATE on no-op -> zero hot-loop cost). Prod = producers write private dirs, assemble Syncs into build/<variant> as sole writer (overlap-immune). Producers take explicit output dir + declare file-granular outputs (render's whole-dir outputs.dir must be tightened). Shared TS/hooks stay in skills/pkg (gemini uses them too). Task 21 lands the check + dev assembleClaudeDev.

plan-71-v12: overlap-check walks disk (corrects v11's 'never walk the tree'). The Task-21 spike disproved the cheap declared-output check: Gradle Copy tasks declare a DIRECTORY output, not files, so it can't distinguish dist/*.js from dist/session-start-config.json without disk-walking or fragile hand-enumeration. The check now globs each producer's output dir after they run and asserts real files pairwise-disjoint. Cheap (~15 files, ms). dependsOn the producers.

plan-71-v13: Bazel-inspired exact-output declaration resolves the overlap-check. After two rejected designs (declared-DIR check can't see files; naive disk-walk can't attribute co-deposited files), adopt Bazel's 'declare exact output files' model: each producer declares outputs.file(<each file>) not outputs.dir(). The cheap in-memory declared-output check then works (filter to file entries, assert disjoint, UP-TO-DATE-friendly, no disk walk). A separate completeness pass walks the assembled dir for undeclared strays (Gradle has no Bazel sandbox). Validated by spike v3.

plan-71-v14: scope the overlap-check to PAYLOAD content files only — the .md/.js/.json/.toml/.bat/.ts that land in build/<variant>/, for skills/claude/gemini only. Opt-in per assembleX over an explicit producer list (never auto-discovers tasks); extension allowlist {md,js,json,toml,bat,ts} as a guard so .class files / JARs / generated sources / node_modules can never be dragged in. core/cli/packaging never get the check. (Survey: a fresh build of all 5 variants emits only those extensions.)

plan-71-v15: isolation by audience. assembleClaude* lives in claude/build.gradle.kts, assembleGemini* in gemini/ — each self-contained, naming only its own producers, never referencing the other integration (so the Claude owner needn't understand Gemini's build). Top-level root build.gradle.kts REJECTED (would force both owners into one file). Reusable machinery (VerifyNoOverlappingOutputs + a registerPayloadAssembly helper) lives in buildSrc as common helpers. Corrects the de-risk draft which put assembleClaudeDev in skills/pkg.
